metadata.description: Pre-benchmark performance predictions for gfx1201 (RX 9070 XT) rocBLAS A/B comparison
metadata.purpose: Record estimated performance BEFORE running actual benchmarks, to validate prediction model accuracy

estimation_model.approach: Roofline model with empirical efficiency factors
estimation_model.fallback_kernel: HIP source compiled by hipcc, uses v_fma_f16 scalar FMA path. Cannot use WMMA intrinsics. Efficiency 12-40% of VALU peak depending on shape size.
estimation_model.tuned_kernel: Hand-tuned assembly with v_wmma_f16_16x16x16_f16. Register-tiled, LDS double-buffered, software prefetched. Efficiency 15-55% of WMMA peak depending on shape and alignment.
estimation_model.memory_model: fp16 GEMM: bytes = 2*(M*K + K*N + M*N), AI = 2*M*N*K / bytes
caveats: M=1 decode shapes are memory-bandwidth-bound; both fallback and tuned are limited by DRAM, not compute
PyTorch torch.mm() adds ~5-15us dispatch overhead per call, which dominates for sub-millisecond GEMMs
MoE expert shapes have small M (tokens routed to each expert), limiting compute intensity
Alignment to 16x16 WMMA tile size affects tuned kernel efficiency
Real kernel selection by Tensile size-mapping may not always pick optimal kernel for every shape
These predictions assume fp16 accumulation (HHS); HPA (HSS) would change compute characteristics

interpretation.prefill: Predicted ~8.9x layer-level speedup for prefill workloads (compute-bound, WMMA dominates)
interpretation.decode_batched: Predicted ~3.2x for decode (mix of compute and memory-bound)
interpretation.decode_single: M=1 decode is memory-bandwidth-bound — expect ~1.0-1.2x (WMMA doesn't help when limited by DRAM reads)
interpretation.end_to_end: For full inference (prefill + decode), expect 1.5-2.5x depending on workload mix
